name: text-glow-pulse
title: Glow Pulse
description: Quầng sáng quanh chữ phồng từ 4 lên 16 px rồi tắt dần theo nhịp 1.5 lần mỗi giây, kèm viền sáng mỏng ở đỉnh.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-glow-pulse, written here): Repeat at 1.5 Hz (period 0.667 s): glow blur 4 → 16 px, glow opacity 0.55 → 1, outline 0 → 8 % of font size at 50 % alpha; envelope: 15 % attack (easeOutQuad), then 85 % decay as (1 − x)^2.5 (fast fall, slow tail); core slightly whiter at the peak. CSS keys 0 / 15 / 100 % ease-out. Loop 2 s (3 beats). Params: rate: nhịp (1.5 Hz) · blur: quầng (4 → 16 px) · outline: viền ở đỉnh (8 % cỡ chữ). Each beat: a 15 % attack (ease-out quad), then a fall as (1 − x)^2.5, fast at first with a slow tail.
